title: 福爾柯克水輪
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction
summary: 本課以福爾柯克水輪為入口，深入旋轉升船的浮力平衡、齒輪定向與循環能量。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Falkirk Wheel as its entry point, this course examines buoyant balance, geared orientation and cycle energy in a rotating boat lift. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「成對船槽質量平衡」與「重力轉矩隨角度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Paired gondola mass balance" and "Gravity torque versus angle": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 成對船槽質量平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Paired gondola mass balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「成對船槽質量平衡」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Paired gondola mass balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。但船槽水位差、積水和附著物仍會破壞理想對稱。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「成對船槽質量平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats. Level differences, retained water and deposits can still break the ideal symmetry. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m. Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Paired gondola mass balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「成對船槽質量平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Paired gondola mass balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成對船槽質量平衡
knowledge.text: 水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。但船槽水位差、積水和附著物仍會破壞理想對稱。
knowledge.textEn: Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats. Level differences, retained water and deposits can still break the ideal symmetry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成對船槽質量平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Paired gondola mass balance" is correct?
options: 兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。
水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。
質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。
optionsEn: With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels.
Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats.
A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation.
quiz.explanation: 水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成對船槽質量平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Paired gondola mass balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「成對船槽質量平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Paired gondola mass balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「成對船槽質量平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Paired gondola mass balance", which statement holds?
options: 半圈平均角速度就是所有時刻的實際角速度。
設備保持重力平衡就保證整個服務循環完全不耗電。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: Half-turn mean angular speed equals the actual speed at every instant.
Gravitational balance guarantees zero electrical use over the complete service cycle.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 成對船槽質量平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Paired gondola mass balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「成對船槽質量平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Paired gondola mass balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。把多餘水量與兩槽質量差放在同一張平衡表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position. Place excess water and the two-gondola mass difference in one balance sheet. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以成對船槽質量平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for paired gondola mass balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。把多餘水量與兩槽質量差放在同一張平衡表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position. Place excess water and the two-gondola mass difference in one balance sheet.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以成對船槽質量平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for paired gondola mass balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position.

quiz.question: 要驗證「成對船槽質量平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Paired gondola mass balance"?
options: 比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
管形截面整體慣性矩足夠就能排除所有局部屈曲。
optionsEn: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate tubular section inertia rules out every form of local buckling.
quiz.explanation: 比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 成對船槽質量平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Paired gondola mass balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「成對船槽質量平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Paired gondola mass balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。
knowledge.textEn: Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「成對船槽質量平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Paired gondola mass balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。
質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water.
A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation.
quiz.explanation: 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重力轉矩隨角度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gravity torque versus angle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重力轉矩隨角度」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gravity torque versus angle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。固定轉矩模型無法描述整個半圈動作。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重力轉矩隨角度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle. Gravity torque can approach zero vertically and peak horizontally, so constant torque cannot describe an entire half-turn. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses. Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gravity torque versus angle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重力轉矩隨角度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gravity torque versus angle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重力轉矩隨角度
knowledge.text: 質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。固定轉矩模型無法描述整個半圈動作。
knowledge.textEn: The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle. Gravity torque can approach zero vertically and peak horizontally, so constant torque cannot describe an entire half-turn.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重力轉矩隨角度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gravity torque versus angle" is correct?
options: 質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。
只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。
質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。
optionsEn: A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation.
A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle.
quiz.explanation: 質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重力轉矩隨角度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gravity torque versus angle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重力轉矩隨角度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gravity torque versus angle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重力轉矩隨角度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gravity torque versus angle", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
兩端質量完全平衡就代表旋轉慣量等於零。
預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
Perfectly balanced end masses make rotational inertia equal to zero.
All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重力轉矩隨角度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gravity torque versus angle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重力轉矩隨角度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gravity torque versus angle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。以水平與垂直位置的理論極值檢查角度定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Use opposite rotation to distinguish friction sign and verify consistent angle zero and gravity direction. Use theoretical horizontal and vertical extrema to verify the chosen angular reference. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以重力轉矩隨角度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gravity torque versus angle, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Use opposite rotation to distinguish friction sign and verify consistent angle zero and gravity direction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。以水平與垂直位置的理論極值檢查角度定義。
knowledge.textEn: Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Use opposite rotation to distinguish friction sign and verify consistent angle zero and gravity direction. Use theoretical horizontal and vertical extrema to verify the chosen angular reference.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以重力轉矩隨角度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gravity torque versus angle, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Use opposite rotation to distinguish friction sign and verify consistent angle zero and gravity direction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重力轉矩隨角度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gravity torque versus angle"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。
只量船槽中央水位就能可靠捕捉所有晃蕩最大值。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape.
A central level sensor reliably captures every maximum sloshing response.
quiz.explanation: 將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重力轉矩隨角度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gravity torque versus angle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重力轉矩隨角度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gravity torque versus angle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。
knowledge.textEn: Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重力轉矩隨角度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gravity torque versus angle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。
若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees.
quiz.explanation: 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
